name: Blind Faith
overview: Scripture distinguishes between simple, unexamined belief and faith grounded in the Word of God and a confident trust in His character. While Proverbs warns against accepting every word without discernment, the New Testament reveals that true faith comes by hearing the Word and believing in what is unseen, as Hebrews defines faith as the assurance of things hoped for. Jesus commends those who believe without seeing, emphasizing that genuine faith pleases God and requires a conviction that He rewards those who diligently seek Him.
